skohylder-idraetshal.name: Shoe racks for a sports hall
skohylder-idraetshal.hero_tagline: 43 plywood shoe racks with a bench on top
skohylder-idraetshal.web_summary: 43 shoe racks in birch plywood for a sports hall, with a bench on top, so you can sit and look from the corridor into the hall. The columns and beam are clad in the same plywood.
skohylder-idraetshal.web_story:
For a sports hall we have made 43 shoe racks in birch plywood, set up in one long row along the corridor. A bench runs along the top, so you can sit down and look from the corridor into the hall.

The columns and the continuous beam above are clad in the same plywood, so furniture and building go together. Everything is oiled rather than lacquered, so the surface can be maintained on site and lasts for many years of use in a busy hall.

skohylder-idraetshal.seo_description: 43 shoe racks in natural plywood with a bench and plywood cladding for a sports hall. Built by Nem Inventar.
skohylder-idraetshal.delivery_label: 43 shoe racks · bench · cladding of columns and beam

hou-skole.name: Hou School
hou-skole.hero_tagline: Cloakroom and changing-room furniture built to be repaired
hou-skole.web_summary: Plywood cloakroom furniture with upholstered seating niches and 16 changing units with HPL surfaces and grille screens for Hou School, built so single parts can be replaced.
hou-skole.web_story:
For Hou School we are building the furniture for the cloakroom and the changing rooms to the architect's drawings. The furniture is built so single parts can be replaced if something breaks, instead of replacing the whole piece.

The cloakroom has open shelving units with upholstered seating niches, cabinets with lockable doors and open shoe racks with seats, all in pine plywood. The cushions have water-repellent covers.

In the changing rooms, each unit combines storage and a bench, with a full-height grille screen that divides the room without shutting out air and light. The surfaces are high-pressure laminate, and the units stand on adjustable legs.

The wood is treated with oil rather than lacquer, so the surface can be refreshed on site. We assemble and install everything at the school.
hou-skole.seo_title: Hou School: cloakroom and changing rooms | Nem Inventar
hou-skole.seo_description: Plywood cloakroom furniture with upholstered seating niches and 16 changing units with grille screens for Hou School, built so parts can be replaced.

daginstitution-vinge.name: Vinge daycare centre
daginstitution-vinge.hero_tagline: Children's cloakroom units, toilet cubicles and staff furniture for a new daycare centre
daginstitution-vinge.web_summary: Fixed furniture for Vinge daycare centre: 92 children's cloakroom units in oiled pine, toilet cubicles in compact laminate, tall cabinets for wet rooms, staff lockers and a mobile kitchen island.
daginstitution-vinge.web_story:
For Vinge daycare centre we are making the fixed furniture for the cloakrooms, toilets, nappy-changing rooms and staff rooms. It is all made in our own production and installed together in one go.

The cloakroom units have one module per child, with hooks at the top and a deeper base with a shoe grille for shoes and boots. They are oiled in two colours, red and blue, so the rows are divided up and the children quickly learn their own place.

The toilet cubicles and the privacy screens by the changing tables are compact laminate, which stands up to water and daily cleaning, and the tall cabinets in the wet rooms have visible surfaces in the same material. The cubicles stand on adjustable legs, so the floor can be washed underneath, and the corners are rounded for the children's sake.

For the staff we are making lockers, a bench with a hanging rail and a mobile kitchen island that can be wheeled to wherever it is needed.

bolholmen-stenlose.name: Bølholmen, Stenløse
bolholmen-stenlose.hero_tagline: 230 identical vanity units in compact laminate for 220 homes
bolholmen-stenlose.web_summary: 230 identical vanity units in compact laminate for 220 homes in the renovation of the Bølholmen housing blocks in Stenløse for Enemærke & Petersen. Delivered and in use.
bolholmen-stenlose.web_story:
In the renovation of the housing blocks at Bølholmen in Stenløse, we have delivered 230 identical vanity units in compact laminate for 220 homes, working for the main contractor Enemærke & Petersen.

Compact laminate is solid high-pressure laminate (HPL). The board does not absorb water, the edges can be left untreated, and the surface stands up to daily cleaning, so the cabinets keep their look for many years.

The cabinets have been delivered and are in use.

morkhoj-skole.name: Mørkhøj School
morkhoj-skole.hero_tagline: School furniture, drawn room by room
morkhoj-skole.web_summary: Fixed furniture for Mørkhøj School in collaboration with Ason A/S and Rønnow Arkitekter: 342 lockers with shoe shelves, approx. 300 m² acoustics, 68 glass boards, upholstered niches, tall cabinets and kitchenettes, all made to measure for the school.
morkhoj-skole.web_story:
At Mørkhøj School we are delivering the fixed furniture in collaboration with the main contractor Ason A/S and Rønnow Arkitekter. Every room is drawn in 3D and approved before we start production, and the furniture is delivered in stages that follow the construction schedule.

In the cloakrooms there are red lockers with benches and shoe shelves. In the classrooms we have delivered tall cabinets in the school's colours, window sills with seating, and board walls with glass boards and notice boards.

In the shared areas we have built upholstered niches into the walls, so pupils can sit and work in small groups. There are also kitchenettes with blue fronts and seating along the walls.

Textile acoustic panels dampen the sound in classrooms and shared areas, and the installation walls are clad, so the services sit behind a calm surface.

Everything is made in our own production and drawn for this particular school. We have handled the site survey, agreeing colours and materials with the architect and the client, production drawings, coordinating the deliveries in stages, and installation.

The school is a Nordic Swan Ecolabel building. For the building's materials log we have supplied a list of the materials the furniture is built from, and a timber account showing the share of certified wood.
morkhoj-skole.seo_title: Mørkhøj School: school furniture | Nem Inventar
morkhoj-skole.seo_description: Fixed furniture for Mørkhøj School with Ason A/S and Rønnow Arkitekter: lockers, tall cabinets, niches, kitchenettes and acoustics, delivered in stages.
morkhoj-skole.delivery_label: 342 lockers · 342 shoe shelves · 52 stained side screens · 14 tall cabinets · 19 upholstered niches and seats · 6 kitchenettes · 68 glass boards · approx. 300 m² acoustics · approx. 100 m² installation walls

partners.title: Collaboration on the surface finish
partners.text: The surface treatment at Mørkhøj School was a project in itself. All the timber furniture is oiled in two colours mixed for us together with Rubio Monocoat and Rubio Monocoat Denmark, with Precolor Easy as the colour and Oil Plus 2C as the protection, so the surface can be maintained spot by spot for many years. We are proud of the collaboration.

roles.Rubio Monocoat Denmark: Danish branch · advice and colour mixing

idraetspark-koebenhavn.name: Sundby Sports Park
idraetspark-koebenhavn.hero_tagline: Changing rooms and a club kitchen for two halls
idraetspark-koebenhavn.web_summary: Benches in solid pine, plywood locker cabinets and wash counters in compact laminate for the changing rooms, and a kitchenette for the club meeting room at Sundby Sports Park.
idraetspark-koebenhavn.web_story:
For two halls at Sundby Sports Park we are making the fixed furniture for the changing rooms and the club meeting room. Everything is made to measure from the drawings, and we deliver and install it.

In the changing rooms we are putting up 150 metres of benches in solid pine: wall benches along the walls and freestanding benches in the middle of the rooms. On top of that come locker cabinets with 150 lockable compartments in lacquered plywood.

The wash counters are compact laminate in five colours that divide up the rooms, each with a basin and tap. They sit on a pine frame and stand up to water and hard daily use. We handle all of it: site survey, production, delivery and installation.

In the club meeting room we are building a kitchenette in pine plywood with a linoleum worktop and room for a dishwasher and a freezer.
